text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Portugal says it will back Morocco in its efforts to convert northern provinces into more developed areas.
- Candidates for elections of local councils to start campaigning.
- Morocco says it would welcome Former Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko if necessary.
- United Nations Secretary General Koffi Annan says he is heartened by recent tour of his special envoy James Baker in Western Sahara.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets Portugal's President Jorge Sampaio over visa procedures within Europe and EU financial support in Morocco's northern provinces.
